Watch weekdays at one and look for the weekly code word to enter. Days of Our Lives, all new weekdays at one, only on W Stream on Stack TV.

explicit_propositions.text: W Network and Stack TV are hosting a contest to celebrate the 60th anniversary of Days of Our Lives.
New episodes air weekdays at one o'clock.
The contest offers a prize package including a three-night stay in Los Angeles.
The prize includes a VIP tour of the Days of Our Lives filming set.
The prize includes a helicopter ride over Los Angeles.
Contestants must watch new episodes of Days of Our Lives to qualify.
A weekly code word will be provided during broadcasts to enable entry into the contest.
The show is available exclusively on W Stream via Stack TV.

assumptions.text: Viewers who watch the show regularly are likely to be engaged fans interested in unique experiences.
The concept of a 'fan experience' holds value and appeal to the target audience.
Audiences trust promotional messages from official network partners like W Network and Stack TV.
Providing clear instructions increases participation likelihood.
Celebrating a milestone anniversary justifies special promotional events.
